items.title_en: China Builds 288-Meter Outdoor Elevator to Help Children Reach School Easier
items.title_zh: 中国建造288米户外电梯帮助孩子们更轻松上学
items.summary_en: In 2022, authorities in Yunnan Province inaugurated the 268-meter Qingyun Ladder elevator to help the children of Nizhuhe village, located deep inside the Nizhu River Grand Canyon, reach their school without having to climb for hours. Every three weeks or so, the children had to undertake a perilous three-hour climb to the Guanzhai Village Primary School, but the elevator built alongside a vertical cliffside took them up the mountain in a matter of minutes. items.summary_zh: 2022年，云南省有关部门启用了268米长的青云梯电梯，帮助位于泥珠河大峡谷深处的泥珠河村的孩子们，无需爬上几个小时就能到达学校。每隔三周左右，孩子们就必须危险地爬上三个小时才能到达官寨村小学，但沿着垂直悬崖边建造的电梯只需几分钟就能带他们上山。青云梯电子
